row.title: LANE-WORKER-MERGE-1 proven: workflow PR merged by the app in 2.9 min
row.body: PR 1090, a workflow comment, was merged by the org app bot from the lane workflow_run in 2.9 minutes. The Worker route accepts an OIDC token for refs/heads/main, so the lane workflow calls it and the in-run pull_request job skips it.
